_comment: Player of the match and the post-match interview (docs/channel.md §7a). The pick scores each player's match stats with potm.weights (a scorcher counts as a goal plus scorcher; tackles 0.05 and shots on target 0.1 from 2026-10-18, were 0.3 each: players make 7 to 21 tackles a match, which decided it over goals, Tom's note 6), plus winBonus for the winning side (shootouts included); ties go to the winning side, then a seeded pick. quotes: canned lines by role (scorer: scored; keeper: the keeper; other) and result from the player's side, one picked per match, seeded. Task 133 (vision §12): voices: the player of the match speaks in their birth region's voice, a man's or a woman's by their first name (data/regions.json womensNames), all ElevenLabs Library voices Tom picked by ear. Quotes have no blanks, so each is one recorded clip per voice; the team, the opponent and the numbers are on the lower third. Voices or AI-written quotes replace these later (vision §12).

win: The points stay with us. I'll take that every week.
The ball was glowing and I just thought: hit it. Glad I did.
They made us work, but once the first one went in I felt it.
The team kept finding me in space. I only had to finish it off.
draw: Nice to score, but I wanted all three points. We go again.
Goals for me and still only a draw. That one will sting on the bus home.
They never gave up. Fair result, if I'm honest.
loss: Goals don't mean much when you lose. We have to be better.
I'd swap my goals for a win in a heartbeat. Tough day for us.
We gave them too many chances. Back to the training ground.

win: Saves? I stopped counting. The defence made it easy for me.
When the heat is on, you just stay big and trust your hands.
Clean hands, happy fans. Good night's work for us.
draw: I kept us in it. A point feels fair.
Busy afternoon, and we still nicked a point.
They threw everything at us. I'm proud we held on for a draw.
loss: I made a few stops, but it wasn't enough. Credit to them.
Plenty of saves and we still lost. That's this game for you.
Some days the ball just finds a way past you. We move on.

win: My job is to win the ball and give it to the strikers. Job done.
Big team performance. I just did my bit.
We kept the ball cool and picked our moments. Great result.
draw: Hard work in the middle today. A point is no disaster.
We had chances to win it. Next time we take them.
Tough game. Nobody stopped running from the first whistle to the last.
loss: Nice award, wrong result. We have to regroup.
We were second best today. No excuses.
I'll take the award, but I'd rather have the points.

_talk: Talk that remembers (Task 245; vision §12 4½): when the facts module (src/chronicle/facts.js) has something about the player of the match or their team that fits the result, the interview is two sentences, each its own clip: a reaction (reactions, by the result from their side) and a fact (facts, by the fact's kind, or kind.variant: milestone by stat, old_club by how they left, late_decider by what it decided, likely_last.champion, final_rematch.revenge); the heaviest fact with a way for the result is said. Otherwise one of quotes, as before. Each way's results: the results it fits. Every line first person, gender-neutral, with no numbers and no team names (Tom), so each is one clip a voice. A player kind is said only by that player; a team kind by anyone on that team.

draw: A point, and we'll take it.
Not quite the result we wanted.
We'll have to settle for a draw.

first_goal.say: My first goal in this league, and it came in a win!
I've waited a long time for that first goal.
First goal for me, and I'm still buzzing.
My first goal, though I'd trade it for a better result.

milestone.goals.say: To reach that many goals in this league is really special.
Another landmark goal, and that one means a lot.

milestone.assists.say: I love setting up my teammates, so that landmark means a lot.
All those assists, and I've enjoyed every one.

milestone.appearances.say: That many games in this league, and I still love every one.
Reaching that many games is a proud moment for me.

milestone.saves.say: That many saves, and my hands are still going strong.
Reaching that landmark as a keeper makes me proud.

milestone.stops.say: Winning the ball back is what I do, and that landmark shows it.
All those tackles and blocks, and I'd make every one again.

record.say: To put my name in the record books is something else.
Breaking that record is a dream come true.
The record's nice, but I wanted the result more.

back_from_injury.say: It's been a long road back from that injury.
After that injury, this feels amazing.
Just good to be back out there with the team.

old_club.let_go.say: They let me go, so beating them feels extra special.
I think I proved a point against my old club.

old_club.left.say: I loved my time there, but I made the right move.
Beating my old club is a strange feeling, but a good one.

likely_last.say: If that's my last game, I'm going out with a win.
If that was my last game, I've loved every minute of it.
Whatever happens next, I'm proud of my career.

likely_last.champion.say: If that's my last game, what a way to go out.
Lifting the Cup in what might be my last game is perfect.

one_more_season.say: Everyone thought I was done, but I'm not finished yet.
I came back for one more season, and this is why.
I'm still here, and I still love it.

scorcher_decider.say: When the ball's that hot at the end, you just hit it.
A late scorcher to decide it, I've dreamed of that.
A scorcher to save a point, I'll take that.

momentum_decider.say: We had the momentum at the end, and we made it count.
Once we got the momentum, I knew we'd get something.

late_decider.winner.say: Scoring the winner that late is the best feeling there is.
Last few minutes, and it falls to me. Amazing.
I just kept believing the chance would come.

late_decider.equaliser.say: Getting us level at the death feels like a win.
We never gave up, and that late goal proves it.

late_decider.golden_goal.say: A golden goal! I'll never forget that one.
Next goal wins, and it was mine. Unbelievable.

goal_haul.say: Scoring that many in one game, I'm keeping the match ball.
Everything I hit seemed to go in.
All those goals, and I'd swap them for the win.
Some days you just know it's going to go in.
My teammates kept finding me, and I kept finishing.
I could have kept shooting all day.

comeback.say: We never stopped believing, even when we were down.
What a comeback, the dressing room will be rocking.
Nobody gave us a chance at that point, but look at us now.

win_run.say: We're on a great run, and we want to keep it going.
Win after win, the confidence is flowing.
Nobody wants to play us right now.

winless_ended.say: That's been a long time coming. Finally, a win.
We needed that win so badly.

head_to_head_ended.say: We hadn't beaten them in a long time, so that's sweet.
They've had our number for a while. Not this time.

head_to_head_run.say: We seem to have their number at the moment.
We always seem to raise our game against them.

final_rematch.say: We beat them in the final, and we've done it again.

final_rematch.revenge.say: They beat us in the final, so this one meant a lot.
We've waited a long time to get them back for that final.

first_final.say: Our first ever final. I can't wait.
This club has never been to a final before. What a feeling.

final_drought_ended.say: It's been a long wait for this club to reach a final.
Our fans have waited so long for another final.

finals_in_a_row.say: Another final! This group just keeps delivering.
Final after final, I'm so proud of this team.

first_cup.say: The first Cup in the club's history, and I'm part of it.
We've made history. Nobody can take that away.

cup_drought_ended.say: This club has waited so long for this Cup.
All those years without the Cup, and now it's ours.

cups_in_a_row.say: Champions again! This team just doesn't stop.
Winning it once is hard. Doing it again is something else.

dynasty.say: This team keeps winning Cups, and I'm proud to be part of it.
People will remember this team for a long time.

_strip: The fact strip (Task 247a, Tom's look A): the fact on screen under the name and stat line while the fact sentence is said, by the same key as facts; a graphic, so names and numbers are fine: {n} the fact's number, {team} and {opponent} short names, {minute}, {seasons}, {milestone} (100TH GOAL), {record} (ALL-TIME GOALS RECORD · 153).

strip.old_club.let_go: BEAT {opponent}, WHO LET THEM GO · {n} SEASONS THERE
